Engineering Portfolio

A modular, asynchronous Python pipeline integrating live data APIs, local LLM synthesis, and constraint-based optimization.

Role: Software & Systems Engineer Timeline: June 2026 - Present
HTML

The Engineering Problem & Objective

The Engineering Problem

Manually aggregating, normalizing, and analyzing data from disparate sources (live market APIs, unstructured news feeds, and raw legal documents) is slow, error-prone, and unscalable. Traditional retail tools lack the institutional-grade data synthesis required for robust, risk-adjusted decision-making, creating a need for an automated, closed-loop data pipeline.

Objective & Relevance

Architect a modular, asynchronous Python application that fetches raw data, processes unstructured text using local machine learning models, and outputs structured, actionable insights via a real-time dashboard. This demonstrates proficiency in building robust data acquisition systems, handling asynchronous data streams, and deploying local AI models—skills directly transferable to automated testing rigs, sensor data logging, and mechatronics control software.

System Architecture

Data Ingestion Layer

Utilizes the OpenBB SDK and custom wrappers to securely fetch, normalize, and cache data from multiple external APIs (Market Data, NewsAPI, Sophtron) simultaneously without blocking the main thread.

Processing & Synthesis Layer

Runs asynchronously to prevent UI freezing. Utilizes custom Python scripts and Regex to parse raw text, feeding clean data into a locally hosted Large Language Model (Ollama/Llama 3.1) for synthesis and risk extraction.

Visualization & Output Layer

A multi-page Streamlit application that visualizes the processed data and executes constraint-based mathematical optimization logic (PyPortfolioOpt) to generate actionable, capital-constrained recommendations.

Core Technical Implementations

Asynchronous Data Fetching

Migrated from synchronous, blocking scripts to an asynchronous architecture using Python's `asyncio`, significantly reducing data latency and preventing UI freezes during heavy, concurrent API calls.

Local LLM Deployment & NLP

Deployed Llama 3.1 locally via Ollama to ensure zero data leakage and zero API costs. Built a custom web scraper using BeautifulSoup and Regex to extract specific legal risk factors from raw SEC filings before feeding them to the LLM.

Constraint-Based Optimization

Integrated mathematical optimization libraries (PyPortfolioOpt) to process raw algorithmic scores and generate actionable, constraint-based rebalancing recommendations based on user-defined capital limits.

Software Engineering Best Practices

Modular Design

Strict separation of concerns. The codebase is divided into distinct directories (`core/` for business logic, `pages/` for UI, `utils/` for helpers), making the system highly maintainable and scalable for future feature additions.

Version Control

Managed entirely through Git/GitHub with structured commit histories, feature branching, and a comprehensive `README.md` detailing setup, dependencies, and system architecture.

Environment Management

Utilized `.env` files for secure API key and credential management, ensuring no sensitive tokens or personal brokerage data were ever pushed to the public repository.

Challenges & Problem Solving

Challenge

Initial synchronous API calls caused the Streamlit UI to freeze and timeout during large, concurrent data fetches.

Resolution

Refactored the data ingestion layer to use Python’s `asyncio` and asynchronous HTTP requests, decoupling heavy computation from the real-time UI and ensuring a smooth user experience.

Challenge

Feeding raw, unfiltered SEC filings directly into the LLM caused context-window overflow and hallucinated outputs.

Resolution

Implemented a deterministic pre-processing step using Regex to extract only the specific 'Item 1A: Risk Factors' text, drastically reducing token count and improving LLM accuracy and relevance.

Challenge

Privacy concerns regarding sending proprietary or sensitive financial data to cloud-based AI APIs.

Resolution

Pivoted to a local LLM deployment using Ollama, ensuring 100% data privacy, zero inference latency, and no external API costs.
